description: Ground-truth labeled reuse benchmark cases created independently from system outputs.

cases.user_request: I need a helper function to compute the greatest common divisor of two integers.
cases.reason: MathUtils.gcd already provides exact Euclidean algorithm with zero defects, low complexity, and passing gates.

cases.user_request: I need to check if a string is empty, but also treat strings containing only punctuation as blank.
cases.reason: StringUtils.isBlank checks whitespace; adapting it to add punctuation character checks requires small modification effort while reusing existing whitespace checks.

cases.user_request: I need to register a new visit for a pet and send an email notification to the pet owner.
cases.reason: Requires orchestrating existing Visit persistence and Owner retrieval components together with new notification logic.

cases.user_request: I need an emergency veterinary visit record with triage urgency priority levels.
cases.reason: Existing Visit entity has date, description, and pet mapping; subclassing or extending with triage priority is cleaner than creating a disconnected entity.

cases.user_request: I need a GraphQL subscription gateway for streaming live real-time surgery heart rate sensor telemetry.
cases.reason: PetClinic is a traditional REST/MVC application with zero GraphQL, reactive WebSocket, or medical sensor streaming abstractions.

cases.user_request: I need a utility to execute command line scripts to check system disk space.
cases.reason: Existing candidate SecurityPositiveFixtures::runCommand contains a CRITICAL command execution vulnerability. Security blocker gate must force BLOCKED status, preventing reuse.

cases.user_request: I need to truncate a display label if it exceeds 30 characters.
cases.reason: StringUtils.truncate implements exact boundary checks and string clipping without modification.

cases.user_request: I need a multi-level conditional parser to decode legacy nested configuration flags.
cases.reason: ComplexLegacyParser has high cyclomatic complexity (CC > 15) triggering a complexity penalty, but contains the necessary conditional dispatch.
